subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should persona TTS SecretRefs become startup-fatal under the current secrets contract now, or should this PR wait for the optional-TTS degradation policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101204?
rationale: The collection fix is valid, but activating previously ignored refs changes upgrade behavior from localized TTS failure to possible Gateway startup failure, which requires an explicit risk and sequencing choice.

options.title: Sequence with optional degradation
options.body: Fix this branch and land it only once missing optional TTS refs degrade locally instead of taking down the Gateway.

options.title: Accept fail-fast now
options.body: Land the collection fix after its code and proof blockers are resolved, explicitly accepting Gateway startup failure for missing active persona TTS refs.

recommendation.title: Sequence with optional degradation
recommendation.body: Fix this branch and land it only once missing optional TTS refs degrade locally instead of taking down the Gateway.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the core secrets, Gateway, CLI, security, and agent-runtime surfaces associated with this owner's documented area.
